header: Six course areas, taught in four houses
lead: Choose a subject first. Each area page lists the dates for Marnau, Steintal, Ottenbrunn and Lindfeld.

items.title: Languages
items.description: 22 languages from A1 to C1, plus conversation evenings open to everyone.

items.title: Digital skills
items.description: From a first email account to spreadsheets, accounting software and safe online banking.

items.title: Business and accounting
items.description: Bookkeeping, payroll and the commercial exam for the trade licence. In the evening or over four Saturdays.

items.title: Health and care
items.description: Care assistance, first aid at work and the refresher hours the care register requires every two years.

items.title: Trades and technology
items.description: Welding tickets, the annual electrical safety check and machine courses in the Steintal workshop.

items.title: Basic education
items.description: Reading, writing and maths for adults, and the school-leaving certificate in four terms, free of charge.
